It has a black vulcanite stem with a white cloverleaf inset and a silver-colored band at the junction. There is some residue visible inside the bowl, but the wood grain and stem display well. The pipe is a collectible item marked clearly on the shank.

279791841.description: This is a vintage Hemingray-14 glass insulator made in the USA, marked with 'HEMINGRAY-14' and 'MADE IN U.S.A. 20-49'. The insulator is clear glass with discoloration and age-related wear consistent with use. Originally used on telegraph, telephone, or electric power lines, this piece represents historical utility equipment. It is a collectible item valued for its industrial heritage.

Bendos Action Figure Lot - 8 Pieces
Kid Galaxy, Inc., Vintage 2000 Era
Collection of eight vintage Bendos action figures by Kid Galaxy, dating to the year 2000. Known for their flexible, wire-framed bodies and distinctively stylized designs, Bendos were a popular collectible line that offered a wide variety of characters. This lot features a diverse assortment including robots, martial artists, and professionals, all preserved in their original tube packaging.
Figures Included:
AC Robot (#046), Spin Robot (#047), and Dian Ninja (#089)
Sam Samurai (#035) and Hocus Pocus Wizard (#280)
Wade Fisherman (#098) and Jack Racetrack Flagger (#086)
Blades Inline Skater (#255)
Condition:
Figures are new and factory sealed in original clear tube packaging. Several tubes show varying degrees of shelf wear, including visible dents and crushing to the plastic. Some original retail price stickers remain on the tubes. Figures inside appear untouched and in excellent condition with no visible fading.
